findings.rfp_quote: Deliver a browser dashboard covering all eight properties and 80 meters, with daily and monthly kWh totals and comparisons by property; ingest one daily CSV file per property from the existing SFTP feed without replacing meters or adding hardware.
findings.response_quote: We will replace the existing SFTP CSV ingestion route with 80 new connected meter gateways, installed across all eight properties.
findings.rationale: New gateways and replacement of the required CSV feed violate the hardware and integration constraints.
findings.suggested_fix: Retain the existing SFTP feed and implement the dashboard without additional hardware.

findings.rfp_quote: Generate downloadable monthly property reports in PDF and CSV with kWh totals, completeness percentages, and clearly labeled estimated values; do not calculate tenant invoices or automatically control building equipment.
findings.response_quote: The system will automatically issue tenant invoices and adjust building equipment to reduce waste.
findings.rationale: Both added capabilities are explicitly excluded by the RFP.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove invoice generation and equipment control from delivered scope.

findings.rfp_quote: The fixed total must not exceed EUR 90,000 excluding VAT, including implementation, historical import, training, and the first 12 months from full rollout of support, hosting, and all required licenses; itemize these costs.
findings.rationale: The correct line-item sum is EUR 92,000, exceeding the cap by EUR 2,000.
findings.suggested_fix: Provide an all-inclusive fixed total at or below EUR 90,000.

findings.rfp_quote: Identify assumptions, exclusions, and dependencies on file delivery, meter mapping, and data quality; quantify required license costs and describe how any added scope receives written approval before charges.
findings.response_quote: We guarantee a 30% reduction in electricity consumption in the first month and completely accurate reports from launch, irrespective of missing source readings.
findings.rationale: Absolute savings and accuracy claims have no baseline or supported treatment of incomplete source data.
findings.suggested_fix: Present bounded reporting commitments and disclose the limitations of missing data and savings estimates.

findings.rfp_quote: Identify assumptions, exclusions, and dependencies on file delivery, meter mapping, and data quality; quantify required license costs and describe how any added scope receives written approval before charges.

notes: The week-8 pilot and week-16 rollout meet the requested dates on paper; unsupported dependency claims are assessed separately.
